manifest_row.title: Novelist Sigrid Nunez On Climate Change, Mortality And Life In A Pandemic

screening.main_topic: Interview with novelist Sigrid Nunez about her novel, mortality, end-of-life choices, the pandemic, and her writing life.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change is described as one of the threats to civilization explored in the novel, and the interview explicitly mentions the possible death of the planet from climate change and global warming. However, the discussion is mainly about the novel's broader themes and the pandemic rather than climate change itself.
screening.reason: The text contains meaningful climate discourse in its framing of the novel and in the discussion of the narrator's ex, who writes and speaks about climate change among other existential threats. Climate is nevertheless a secondary element of a literary interview, so the text is peripheral rather than core climate coverage.
